challenge.method: Compare the nil map and missing-entry cases with an entry explicitly storing an element zero value and with the nil-map assignment rule at 3961–3964.
challenge.results: An existing zero-valued entry yields a true presence indicator. A nil map or missing entry yields false and the zero value of the element type. The nearby panic rule applies to assigning an entry.

limitations: The review covers a lookup in one of the cited two-result forms using an assignable string or integer key. The map update rule is separate.
